lines.text: Sit down or put it away. The cards don't care.
You drew on the Row. We saw. Everybody saw. Run, or sit very still.
Curfew. The Stair's shut. House rule: nobody leaves the table till the Wardens open it.
The Choir lot are all smiling. Means the Lattice is strange tonight. Don't play a Cantor.
Deal you in? You know the house rules. You wrote half of them.
We don't bite on the Row. That's the arrangement. Don't ask whose.
Cards are Sable's. So's the peace. Pull up a crate.

barks.text: Somebody sold a Halvard pass for two hundred. Expired, of course.
Nobody draws on the Row. Somebody always thinks they're the exception.
Halo's down the end. Vesper sees you before you see her. Cards are quicker.
Enforcers don't play. They watch the hands. Not the cards, the hands.
Sable doesn't run this street. Sable just knows what it costs.
